_help.SmtpServer: FQDN of an on-prem Exchange server (or the load-balanced SMTP name) whose Receive connector accepts mail from this host.
_help.SmtpPort: 25 for a relay Receive connector (Frontend Transport), 587 for the client submission connector.
_help.UseTls: true = STARTTLS. Keep it on. The Exchange certificate must be trusted by this host, or set TlsAllowUntrustedCertificate = true in a lab.
_help.AuthMode: Anonymous (relay connector scoped to this host's IP, recommended) | CurrentUser (Kerberos/NTLM as the account running the task) | Credential (username + password from CredentialXmlPath).
_help.CredentialXmlPath: Only used when AuthMode = Credential. Create it with Install-help\New-SmtpCredentialFile.ps1. DPAPI-protected: it can only be read by the same Windows account on the same machine that created it.
_help.ExchangePowerShellUri: Exchange remote PowerShell endpoint. Used ONLY by the Exchange certificate importer plugin, never by the main script.
_help.ExchangeAuthentication: Kerberos (domain-joined host, recommended) | Basic (needs https and ExchangeCredentialXmlPath).
_help.ExchangeCredentialXmlPath: Only used when ExchangeAuthentication = Basic. Create it with Install-help\New-SmtpCredentialFile.ps1 -OutFile Settings\Config\exchange-credential.xml.
